notes: Solitaire now supports drag and drop as the primary way to move cards, with click-to-move kept as a fallback. Drag is pointer-based so it works with both mouse and touch: press and drag a card (a face-up tableau card carries its run, or the top of the waste) and drop it on a column or a foundation; a valid target highlights while you hover, and an illegal or off-target drop snaps back. A press without movement still counts as a click, so tap-to-select, double-click-to-foundation, click the stock to draw, and the Auto button all still work. Drag and click both go through the same move validation, so the server-authoritative scoring is unchanged and the client and server deals still match byte-for-byte. Also updated the in-game tutorial to list all eleven casino games (it previously listed eight and omitted Baccarat, Sic Bo, and Solitaire). Client only, no server or DB change, but hard-refresh (Ctrl+Shift+R) is required to pick up the new assets. Carries 1.1.9.12 and earlier.
